cpu.prompt: Explain in two sentences why the sky is blue.
cpu.text: Sunlight appears white but is actually composed of all the colors of the rainbow, which travel in different directions. When this light hits the Earth's atmosphere, shorter blue wavelengths are scattered more widely by air molecules than the longer red wavelengths, making the sky appear blue to our eyes.
